source.pc: In this skill you learn to simplify products with powers in them. This could be the product of two powers, turning into , it could be the power of a product, turning into , or it could be the power of a power, turning into . It basically includes any rewriting where you have to keep in mind that a power is nothing more than a repeated multiplication. This skill also includes the potential simplification of number products. It does not include negative powers like , fractions like or expanding powers of sums like .
